chapters.label: Stoke, 2012
chapters.text: Stoke, 2012, the Premier League: Stoke, in red and white stripes, against Manchester City, in sky blue. A long ball, Crouch heads it on, Pennant heads it back... Peter Crouch volleys from thirty yards. Goal!

chapters.label: No look
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He faces the corner flag, pops it up, and without looking at goal, volleys it across his body.

chapters.label: Over Hart
chapters.text: It dips over Joe Hart into the far top corner! Crouch said it was probably his best goal ever.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep your eyes on the dropping ball, and strike it cleanly before it bounces.
